questions.text: In the context of training a machine learning model for loan approval, what is the purpose of the debt-to-income ratio?
options: The label indicating loan approval or rejection
The error metric minimized during training
A measurable characteristic (feature) used to describe each loan applicant
The total number of training examples
questions.explanation: The debt-to-income ratio is a feature describing each applicant.

questions.text: Which type of learning involves the model receiving a reward or penalty after each action to improve its long-term strategy?
questions.explanation: Reinforcement learning uses rewards/penalties to adjust strategies over time.

questions.text: True or false: Overfitting makes a model more accurate when faced with new, unseen data.
questions.explanation: Overfitting causes poor generalization to new data.

questions.text: True or false: In unsupervised learning, the model is given labeled examples to learn the correct output for each input.
questions.explanation: Unsupervised learning works with unlabeled data to find hidden patterns.
